text:
**STEP 1 - Scene:** A breakfast tray with cereal, bread, an English muffin, an almond muffin, butter packets, milk and water.

**STEP 2 - Vessels:** Cereal bowl about 15 cm (area ~177 cm²). Side plate about 20 cm (area ~314 cm²). The milk bottle and water glass are beverages, not plated food.

**STEP 3 - Items:** Dry cereal flakes in the bowl; an English muffin, two slices of multigrain bread, and an almond-topped muffin on the plate; two butter packets; milk in the bottle.

**STEP 4 - Area:**
- Cereal: about 60% of the bowl, so ~106 cm².
- English muffin: about 20% of the plate, ~64 cm².
- Bread slices: about 15% of the plate, ~47 cm².
- Almond muffin: about 12% of the plate, ~38 cm² (in its paper cup, overhanging the plate).

**STEP 5 - Volume:**
- Cereal: 106 cm² × 1.5 cm ≈ 159 ml.
- English muffin: 64 cm² × 2.5 cm ≈ 160 ml.
- Bread: 47 cm² × 2 cm ≈ 94 ml.
- Almond muffin: 38 cm² × 4 cm ≈ 150 ml.
- Milk: about one-third of the bottle, ~120 ml.

**STEP 6 - Grams:**
- Cereal: 159 ml × 0.3 (light flakes) ≈ 48 g.
- English muffin: 160 ml × 0.4 ≈ 64 g. I used a lower density than the 0.9 guideline because the muffin is airy; a 0.9 factor would give an implausible ~145 g.
- Bread: two slices ≈ 56 g.
- Almond muffin: 150 ml × 0.4 ≈ 60 g.
- Butter: two packets ≈ 14 g.
- Milk: 120 g.

**STEP 7 - Energy:**
- Cereal: 48 g × 360 kcal/100 g ≈ 173 kcal.
- English muffin: 64 g × 230 ≈ 147 kcal.
- Bread: 56 g × 250 ≈ 140 kcal.
- Almond muffin: 60 g × 380 ≈ 228 kcal.
- Butter: 14 g × 717 ≈ 100 kcal.
- Milk: 120 g × 60 ≈ 72 kcal.

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** About 362 g and ~860 kcal is plausible for a full breakfast tray of this kind. The main uncertainty is the milk amount and whether the packets are butter or jam.
